notes.note: 0718 leader block #0.2-16 (+1+k) follows the Pt_Chara_Check chain Rider 1, OOO, Black RX, W, Den-O Sword, Ultraman, Zero, Seven, Mebius, Taro, Nu, 00, Zeta, Wing Zero, God (verified: #0.6 rough = Den-O). So #0.8-16 here = Zero, Seven, Mebius, Taro, Nu, 00, Zeta, Wing Zero, God; identical Japanese, identical English. 'It' = the Minus Energy Ankh remarks on in #0.1 (story_154). story_154 rows #0.2-7 should use the same English.
Seravee's Voice. Memory Memory kept in quotes as in story_146/149.

0719 leader block #0.3-17 (+2+k), chain order Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W, Den-O Sword, Black RX, Rider 1, 00, Wing Zero, God, Zeta, Nu. Rough endings at #0.3 Zero, #0.9 W, #0.10 Den-O, #0.15 God match the chain; those four get 'damn thing'. #0.13-14 (00, Wing Zero) use a different curt line.
Narration (+19, after the event-end flag check): reused established 'The door is firmly shut.'
Ankh, flag-2728 branch (door already opened by the event in 0721). 'Here' read as 'this is the place' (the spot with the door).
Belial (id 141), voice only, offscreen. 'The other side' = past the door.

0721 blocks #0.7-21, #0.27-41, #0.43-57 use the chain Zero, Ultraman, Mebius, Seven, Taro, OOO, Rider 1, W, Black RX, Den-O Sword, 00, Nu, Wing Zero, Zeta, God (verified: #0.27 rough Zero, #0.32 gentle OOO, #0.34 W 'huh', #0.36 Den-O 'what?!'). Three Japanese forms in block 1 (bare name / 'that's Belial' / 'Belial's voice?') kept distinct.
Den-O Sword (Momotaros): incredulous 'da?' ending rendered as a question-exclamation.

#0.43-47 = Zero, Ultraman, Mebius, Seven, Taro; they differ only by a comma/line break, so identical English. Subject 'we' restored. The rest of the block (#0.48-57, story_156) opens with 'No,' instead of 'But'.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0718/0719/0721 bytecode; extracted labels were correct here, leader variants voiced from the three Pt_Chara_Check chains. No new names; story_154 (#0718 #0.2-7) should reuse this slice's line for the identical concentration rows.
